lede: One story landed on three separate feeds at once: India versus Afghanistan in the Asian Games men's cricket quarter-final, live on Google Trends, Polymarket, and Wikipedia together. In India the match drew an estimated 1,000,000 searches after a washout sent India through to the semi-finals. Elsewhere the evening ran on habit: Counter-Strike 2 held the top of Steam with 1,346,533 players, and paperclipai/paperclip led GitHub trending with 2,401 stars on the day.

throughlines.title: india vs afghanistan
throughlines.gist: An Asian Games men's cricket quarter-final that a rain washout turned decisive, sending India to the semi-finals and pulling search, betting, and encyclopedia traffic on the same day.
